requirements.requirement_text: ESMA shall designate a contact point for receiving the information set out in Articles 3 and 4 and for communications on any issue relating to the reception of that information.

requirements.requirement_text: The information referred to in paragraph 1 shall be provided to ESMA no later than 31 of March of each year and shall relate to all investigations undertaken and all sanctions and measures imposed during the previous calendar year.

requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/1158 of 29 June 2017 laying down implementing technical standards with regards to the procedures and forms for competent authorities exchanging information with the European Securities Market Authority as referred to in Article 33 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall provide ESMA with the information referred to in paragraph 1 by secure electronic means of transmission.
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/1158 of 29 June 2017 laying down implementing technical standards with regards to the procedures and forms for competent authorities exchanging information with the European Securities Market Authority as referred to in Article 33 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: For the purposes of paragraph 1, ESMA shall specify and identify the secure electronic means to be used. Those means shall ensure that the completeness, integrity and confidentiality of the information is maintained during its transmission.
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/1158 of 29 June 2017 laying down implementing technical standards with regards to the procedures and forms for competent authorities exchanging information with the European Securities Market Authority as referred to in Article 33 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Competent authorities shall report to ESMA the sanctions and measures referred to in Article 33(3) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 using the interfaces provided by the information technology system, and the related database, set up by ESMA to manage the receipt, storage and publication of information on those sanctions and measures.
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/1158 of 29 June 2017 laying down implementing technical standards with regards to the procedures and forms for competent authorities exchanging information with the European Securities Market Authority as referred to in Article 33 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The sanctions and measures referred to in paragraph 1 shall be submitted to ESMA in a report file in the format set out in Annex II.
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/1158 of 29 June 2017 laying down implementing technical standards with regards to the procedures and forms for competent authorities exchanging information with the European Securities Market Authority as referred to in Article 33 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where a competent authority wishes to invalidate an existing report file it has previously submitted to ESMA in accordance with Article 4, it shall cancel the existing report file and send a new report file.
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/1158 of 29 June 2017 laying down implementing technical standards with regards to the procedures and forms for competent authorities exchanging information with the European Securities Market Authority as referred to in Article 33 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where a competent authority wishes to update an existing report file it has previously submitted to ESMA in accordance with Article 4, it shall resubmit the report file with the updated information.

requirements.requirement_text: A CSD with access to T2S services shall comply, after it has migrated to T2S, with the five CSD access criteria on an ongoing basis and shall ensure, in particular, through a reliable self-assessment conducted each year and supported by relevant documentation that it continues to comply with CSD access criteria 1, 3, 4 and 5
requirements.applicable_entity: CSDs with access to T2S services
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2019/1006 of the European Central Bank of 7 June 2019 amending Decision ECB/2011/20 establishing detailed rules and procedures for implementing the eligibility criteria for central securities depositories to access TARGET2-Securities services (ECB/2019/15)

requirements.requirement_text: A CSD with access to T2S services shall promptly provide the MIB with the most recent outcome of the assessment conducted by the relevant competent authority against Regulation (EU) No 909/2014, the Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures of the Committee on Payment and Market Infrastructures and the International Organisation of Securities Commissions (PFMI) or a legal framework implementing the PFMI. If the above outcome of the assessment is not available, the CSD shall submit a self-attestation based on the relevant documentation
requirements.applicable_entity: CSDs with access to T2S services
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2019/1006 of the European Central Bank of 7 June 2019 amending Decision ECB/2011/20 establishing detailed rules and procedures for implementing the eligibility criteria for central securities depositories to access TARGET2-Securities services (ECB/2019/15)

requirements.requirement_text: A CSD with access to T2S services shall request a new assessment by the relevant competent authorities of its compliance with Regulation (EU) No 909/2014, the PFMI or a legal framework implementing the PFMI in the event of material changes to the CSD's system
requirements.applicable_entity: CSDs with access to T2S services
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2019/1006 of the European Central Bank of 7 June 2019 amending Decision ECB/2011/20 establishing detailed rules and procedures for implementing the eligibility criteria for central securities depositories to access TARGET2-Securities services (ECB/2019/15)

requirements.requirement_text: A CSD with access to T2S services shall notify the MIB without undue delay where a relevant competent authority assessment or a self-assessment has established non-compliance with any of the five CSD access criteria
requirements.applicable_entity: CSDs with access to T2S services
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2019/1006 of the European Central Bank of 7 June 2019 amending Decision ECB/2011/20 establishing detailed rules and procedures for implementing the eligibility criteria for central securities depositories to access TARGET2-Securities services (ECB/2019/15)

requirements.requirement_text: A CSD with access to T2S services shall, following a request from the MIB, provide an assessment report demonstrating that the CSD still complies with the five CSD access criteria
requirements.applicable_entity: CSDs with access to T2S services
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2019/1006 of the European Central Bank of 7 June 2019 amending Decision ECB/2011/20 establishing detailed rules and procedures for implementing the eligibility criteria for central securities depositories to access TARGET2-Securities services (ECB/2019/15)

requirements.requirement_text: Management companies must take into account sustainability risks when complying with organizational requirements
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Management companies must retain the necessary resources and expertise for the effective integration of sustainability risks
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Investment companies must integrate sustainability risks in the management of UCITS, taking into account the nature, scale and complexity of their business
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Senior management must be responsible for the integration of sustainability risks in company activities
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Management companies must identify and include conflicts of interest that may arise as a result of the integration of sustainability risks in their processes, systems and internal controls
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Management companies must take into account sustainability risks when complying with risk management requirements
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Management companies and investment companies must take into account principal adverse impacts on sustainability factors when complying with risk management requirements, where they consider such impacts
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Risk management policy must include procedures to assess exposure to sustainability risks for each UCITS managed
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Member States must adopt and publish laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with this Directive by 31 July 2022
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Member States must apply transposition measures from 1 August 2022
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Member States must communicate to the Commission the text of transposition provisions
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Member States must communicate to the Commission the text of main provisions of national law adopted in the field covered by this Directive
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1270 of 21 April 2021 amending Directive 2010/43/EU as regards the sustainability risks and sustainability factors to be taken into account for Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: A third country market is to be considered equivalent to a regulated market where that market complies with legally binding requirements that are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and provided that that market is subject to effective supervision and enforcement in that third country on an ongoing basis
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: An exchange must be registered with the SEC as a NSE before it may begin operations
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Registered NSEs are required to maintain rules, policies and procedures consistent with their statutory obligations, and to have the capacity to carry out their obligations on a continuous basis
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: NSEs must provide their members with impartial access to their markets and services
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Registered NSEs are required to have clear and transparent rules regarding the admission of securities to trading so that those securities are capable of being traded in a fair, orderly, and efficient manner and are freely negotiable
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: NSEs are prohibited from listing any security of an issuer that does not comply with the audit committee requirements set out in the SEC rules
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Options markets are required to prepare an options disclosure document with certain specified information about the characteristics and risks of exchange traded options
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Broker-dealers are to provide customers with that options disclosure document, and that document is to be filed with the SEC prior to being furnished to customers
requirements.deadline_text: prior to being furnished to customers
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The OCC is required to disclose annual audited financials publicly
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: An OCC is required to enforce policies and procedures that provide for the public disclosure of all relevant rules and material procedures, including key aspects of its default management rules and procedures, of basic data on transaction volume and values, and of a comprehensive description of its material rules, policies, and procedures regarding its legal, governance, risk management, and operating framework
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: NSEs are required to address any potential violations of the market's rules or the federal securities laws by its members
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: They are required to inform the SEC of significant infringements
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: All registered NSEs are required to be able to enforce compliance by their members and persons associated with their members with the Exchange Act, the rules and regulations thereunder, and their own rules
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: NSEs are required to inform the SEC of any rule changes
requirements.law_title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/552 of 4 April 2022 determining that national securities exchanges of the United States of America that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission comply with legally binding requirements which are equivalent to the requirements laid down in Title III of Directive 2014/65/EU and are subject to effective supervision and enforcement (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Upon completion of an investigation, the investigation officer shall inform the person subject to investigation in writing stating its findings and shall provide that person with the opportunity to make written submissions
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The statement of findings shall set out the facts liable to constitute one or more infringements including an assessment of the nature and seriousness of those infringements
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The statement of findings shall set a reasonable time limit of at least four weeks for the person subject to investigation to make its written submissions
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The investigation officer shall not be obliged to take into account written submissions received after the time limit has expired
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The complete file to be submitted by the investigation officer to ESMA shall include the statement of findings, copy of written submissions, and minutes of any oral hearing
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: When a file is incomplete, ESMA shall make a reasoned request for additional documents to the investigation officer
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where ESMA considers that the facts do not constitute infringements, it shall decide to close the case and shall notify that decision to the person subject to investigation
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where ESMA does not agree with the findings, it shall submit a new statement of findings with a time limit of at least four weeks for written submissions
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: ESMA shall not be obliged to take into account written submissions received after the time limit expiry for adopting decisions on infringements and supervisory measures
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/803 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying rules of procedure for the exercise of the power to impose fines or periodic penalty payments by the European Securities Markets Authority regarding data reporting service providers (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where ESMA agrees with findings, it shall inform the person accordingly and set a time limit of at least two weeks (full agreement) or four weeks (partial agreement) for written submissions
requirements.deadline_text: at least two weeks or four weeks

requirements.requirement_text: A benchmark administrator established in a third country that applies for recognition pursuant to article 32 of Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 shall pay a recognition fee of EUR 40000
requirements.applicable_entity: third country benchmark administrators applying for recognition
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/805 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying fees applicable to the supervision by the European Securities Markets Authority of certain benchmark administrators (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The administrator of a critical benchmark that applies for authorisation in accordance with article 34 of Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 shall pay an application fee of EUR 250000
requirements.applicable_entity: critical benchmark administrators applying for authorisation
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/805 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying fees applicable to the supervision by the European Securities Markets Authority of certain benchmark administrators (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The authorisation fee and the recognition fee shall be paid at the time of the submission of the application, upon receipt of ESMA's debit note

requirements.deadline_text: at the time of the submission of the application, upon receipt of ESMA's debit note

requirements.requirement_text: In the case of the applications received by national competent authorities after 1 October 2021 and transferred to ESMA, the recognition fees shall be paid at the beginning of 2022

requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/805 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying fees applicable to the supervision by the European Securities Markets Authority of certain benchmark administrators (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The administrator of one or more critical benchmarks shall pay an annual supervisory fee of EUR 200000, in cases where ESMA does not have to chair a college of supervisors pursuant to article 46 of Regulation (EU) 2016/1011
requirements.applicable_entity: critical benchmark administrators without college of supervisors

requirements.requirement_text: The minimum annual supervisory fee for recognised third country administrators shall be EUR 20000, including when the applicable turnover of the recognised third country administrator is equal to zero

requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/805 of 16 February 2022 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 of the European Parliament and of the Council by specifying fees applicable to the supervision by the European Securities Markets Authority of certain benchmark administrators (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The supervisory fee of the first year shall be paid after the administrator has been notified by ESMA that its application has been successful and within 30 days from the date of issuance of ESMA's relevant debit note

requirements.deadline_text: within 30 days from the date of issuance of ESMA's relevant debit note

requirements.requirement_text: A recognised third country benchmark administrator shall provide ESMA, on an annual basis, with audited figures confirming its revenues accrued in relation to the use of its benchmarks in the Union

requirements.requirement_text: A trade repository that has not received a corresponding SFT report shall attempt to identify the trade repository that has received the corresponding SFT report by communicating to all registered trade repositories the values of specified fields
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/358 of 13 December 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2015/2365 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the collection, verification, aggregation, comparison and publication of data on securities financing transactions (SFTs) by trade repositories (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: A trade repository that determines that another trade repository has received a corresponding SFT report shall exchange with that trade repository the details of the reported SFT in an XML format and a template developed in accordance with the ISO 20022 methodology
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/358 of 13 December 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2015/2365 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the collection, verification, aggregation, comparison and publication of data on securities financing transactions (SFTs) by trade repositories (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: A trade repository shall seek to match separately the fields pertaining to the loan data and the fields pertaining to the collateral data of a reported SFT in accordance with the tolerance limits and relevant dates of application
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/358 of 13 December 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2015/2365 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the collection, verification, aggregation, comparison and publication of data on securities financing transactions (SFTs) by trade repositories (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: A trade repository shall subsequently assign values for the reconciliation categories for each reported SFT
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/358 of 13 December 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2015/2365 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the collection, verification, aggregation, comparison and publication of data on securities financing transactions (SFTs) by trade repositories (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: A trade repository shall conclude the steps in points (a) to (f) at the earliest opportunity and shall take no such steps after 18:00 Universal Coordinated Time on a given working day
requirements.deadline_text: before 18:00 Universal Coordinated Time on a given working day
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/358 of 13 December 2018 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2015/2365 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on the collection, verification, aggregation, comparison and publication of data on securities financing transactions (SFTs) by trade repositories (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Ms Verena ROSS is hereby appointed as Chair of the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) for a period of 5 years from 1 November 2021
requirements.deadline_text: for a period of 5 years from 1 November 2021
requirements.law_title: Council Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1822 of 15 October 2021 on the appointment of the Chair of the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA)

requirements.requirement_text: This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union
requirements.deadline_text: on the date of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union
requirements.law_title: Council Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1822 of 15 October 2021 on the appointment of the Chair of the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA)

requirements.requirement_text: The requirements set out in Article 77 of Guideline ECB/2014/60 shall not apply to ABS mezzanine tranches that are only eligible for purchase under the ABSPP if they meet specified guarantee and credit assessment requirements
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2015/1613 of the European Central Bank of 10 September 2015 amending Decision (EU) 2015/5 on the implementation of the asset-backed securities purchase programme (ECB/2015/31)

requirements.requirement_text: ABS mezzanine tranches must be secured by a guarantee meeting the requirements for guarantees of marketable assets as set out in Articles 114, 115, 117 and 118 of Part Four, Title IV of Guideline (EU) 2015/510
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2015/1613 of the European Central Bank of 10 September 2015 amending Decision (EU) 2015/5 on the implementation of the asset-backed securities purchase programme (ECB/2015/31)

requirements.requirement_text: Guarantor must have a credit assessment in accordance with Article 83(c) of Guideline ECB/2014/60 and provided by at least one accepted ECAI system, expressed in the form of a public credit rating, in compliance with, as a minimum, credit quality step 3 in the Eurosystem's harmonised rating scale
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2015/1613 of the European Central Bank of 10 September 2015 amending Decision (EU) 2015/5 on the implementation of the asset-backed securities purchase programme (ECB/2015/31)

requirements.requirement_text: ABS mezzanine tranches must satisfy all other applicable eligibility criteria for purchase under the ABSPP
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2015/1613 of the European Central Bank of 10 September 2015 amending Decision (EU) 2015/5 on the implementation of the asset-backed securities purchase programme (ECB/2015/31)

requirements.requirement_text: This Decision shall enter into force on the twentieth day following its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union
requirements.law_title: Decision (EU) 2015/1613 of the European Central Bank of 10 September 2015 amending Decision (EU) 2015/5 on the implementation of the asset-backed securities purchase programme (ECB/2015/31)

requirements.requirement_text: Group data reporting agents shall be heads of banking groups and institutions or financial institutions established in participating Member States and which are not part of a banking group where they have been identified by the Governing Council pursuant to paragraph 4 as part of the actual reporting population, and notified of their reporting obligations pursuant to paragraph 5.
requirements.applicable_entity: heads of banking groups, institutions or financial institutions
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: The actual reporting agents shall be subject to full reporting requirements unless any derogation granted pursuant to Articles 4, 4a or 4b applies.
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: The relevant NCB shall notify the group data reporting agents of the Governing Council's decision pursuant to paragraph 4, and of their obligations under this Regulation.
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: Any group data reporting agent that is notified in accordance with paragraph 5 after the first reporting under this Regulation has started, shall begin reporting data no later than 6 months after the date of notification.
requirements.deadline_text: no later than 6 months after the date of notification
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: A group data reporting agent notified in accordance with paragraph 5 shall inform the relevant NCB of changes to its name or legal form, of mergers or restructurings, and of any other event or circumstances affecting its reporting obligations, within 14 days of the occurrence of such event or circumstances.
requirements.deadline_text: within 14 days of the occurrence of such event or circumstances
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: A group data reporting agent notified in accordance with paragraph 5 shall remain subject to the obligations set out in this Regulation until it receives notification to the contrary by the relevant NCB.
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: Custodians shall report securities they hold in custody for resident clients that do not report their own holdings pursuant to paragraph 1, in accordance with Part 3 of Chapter 1 of Annex I.
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: Custodians shall report securities they hold in custody for non-financial clients resident in other euro area Member States, in accordance with Part 4 of Chapter 1 of Annex I.
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: Custodians shall report securities issued by euro area entities they hold in custody for clients resident in non-euro area Member States and for clients resident outside the Union, in accordance with Part 5 of Chapter 1 of Annex I.
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: Sectoral data reporting agents shall, in accordance with instructions by the relevant NCB, report either (a) security-by-security data on monthly or quarterly financial transactions and, where requested by the relevant NCB, other changes in volume; or (b) the statistical information needed to derive financial transactions on the basis of one of the approaches specified in Part 1 of Chapter 1 of Annex I.
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: Sectoral data reporting agents shall, if instructed by the relevant NCB, report on a quarterly or monthly basis data on end-of-quarter or end-of-month positions and, in accordance with paragraph 5, statistical information over the reference quarter or month, on holdings of securities without an ISIN code, in accordance with Part 7 of Chapter 1 of Annex I.
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1384 of the European Central Bank of 2 August 2016 amending Regulation (EU) No 1011/2012 (ECB/2012/24) concerning statistics on holdings of securities (ECB/2016/22)

requirements.requirement_text: Managers must not exceed the threshold of assets under management as referred to in point (b) of Article 3(2) of Directive 2011/61/EU
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) No 345/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2013 on European venture capital funds (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Managers must be registered with the competent authority in their home Member State in accordance with Directive 2011/61/EU
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) No 345/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2013 on European venture capital funds (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Qualifying venture capital funds must invest at least 70% of their aggregate capital contributions and uncalled committed capital in qualifying portfolio undertakings
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) No 345/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2013 on European venture capital funds (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Qualifying venture capital funds must not invest more than 30% of their aggregate capital contributions and uncalled committed capital in assets other than qualifying investments
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) No 345/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2013 on European venture capital funds (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: A qualifying venture capital fund must be established in the Union in order to be entitled to use the designation EuVECA
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) No 345/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2013 on European venture capital funds (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: A qualifying venture capital fund which is internally managed must not be permitted to be the external manager of other collective investment undertakings or UCITS
requirements.applicable_entity: internally managed qualifying venture capital funds
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) No 345/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2013 on European venture capital funds (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Managers that exceed the threshold and become subject to Directive 2011/61/EU must continue to comply with certain requirements for the use of the designation EuVECA at all times in relation to qualifying venture capital funds
requirements.law_title: Regulation (EU) No 345/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 April 2013 on European venture capital funds (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The most relevant Union currencies shall be identified on the basis of the relative share of each currency in the CCP's average end-of-day open positions across all financial instruments cleared by the CCP, calculated over a period of one year.
requirements.deadline_text: calculated over a period of one year
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The most relevant Union currencies shall be the three currencies with the highest relative share calculated in accordance with paragraph 1, provided that each individual share exceeds 10%.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The calculation of the relative share of the currencies shall be calculated on an annual basis.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: After assessing that an application is complete as referred to in Article 17(3) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012, the CCP's competent authority shall circulate a proposal for the written agreement under Article 18(5) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 to the members of the college determined in accordance with Article 18(2) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: That written agreement shall include a process for annual review. It shall also include an amendment process whereby changes may be initiated at any time by the CCP's competent authority or by other members of the college, subject to approval by the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where the members of the college referred to in paragraph 1 do not express any comments within 10 calendar days, the CCP's competent authority shall proceed with the adoption of the written agreement by the college and with the establishment of the college in accordance with Article 18(1) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where the members of the college express comments regarding the proposal for the written agreement circulated pursuant to paragraph 1, they shall submit those comments together with a thorough explanation to the CCP's competent authority within 10 calendar days.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: If relevant, the CCP's competent authority shall prepare a revised proposal and convene a meeting to agree on the final written agreement taking into account the deadline referred to in Article 18(1) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012.
requirements.deadline_text: taking into account the deadline referred to in Article 18(1)
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: All members of the college will be bound by the written agreement adopted in accordance with paragraphs 1 to 3 of this Article.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where a request for information is made to a college by a competent authority of a Member State which is not a member of the college in accordance with Article 18(3) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012, the CCP's competent authority, after having consulted the college, shall decide on the most appropriate way to provide and request information to and from the authorities that are not members of the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Each member of the college shall designate one participant to attend the meetings of the college and may designate one alternate, with the exception of the CCP's competent authority which may require additional participants who shall have no voting rights.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where the central bank of issue of one of the most relevant Union currencies corresponds to more than one central bank, the relevant central banks shall determine the single representative who will participate in the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: Where in accordance with this Article there is more than one participant from a college member, or there are more college members belonging to the same Member State than number of votes that can be exercised by those college members in accordance with Article 19(3) of Regulation (EU) No 648/2012, that college member or those college members shall inform the college which participants shall exercise voting rights.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority shall ensure that the work of the college facilitates the tasks to be performed in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 648/2012.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The college shall notify ESMA of any tasks that the college performs in accordance with paragraph 1.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority, shall at least ensure that: (a) the objectives of any meeting or activity of the college are clearly identified; (b) the college meetings or activities remain effective, while ensuring that all college members are fully informed of the college activities that are relevant to them; (c) the timetable for meetings or activities of the college is defined so that their outcome provides assistance to the supervision of the CCP; (d) the CCP and other key stakeholders have a clear understanding of the role and functioning of the college; (e) the activities of the college are regularly reviewed and remedial action is taken if the college is not operating effectively; (f) the agenda is set for an annual crisis management planning meeting amongst members of the college in cooperation with the CCP if necessary.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: To ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the college, the CCP's competent authority shall act as a central point of contact for any matter related to the practical organisation of the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority shall at least perform the following tasks: (a) draw-up, update and circulate the contact list of college members; (b) circulate the agenda as well as documentation for meetings or activities of the college; (c) record minutes of the meetings and formalise action points; (d) manage the college website or other electronic information-sharing mechanism, if any; (e) where practical, provide information and specialised teams where appropriate, to assist the college in its tasks; (f) share information in an appropriate manner among members of the college.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: There shall be at least an annual meeting of the college and if deemed necessary by the CCP's competent authority, a meeting each time that a decision needs to be taken under Regulation (EU) No 648/2012.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)

requirements.requirement_text: The CCP's competent authority shall organise, periodically, meetings between members of the college and the senior management of the CCP.
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 876/2013 of 28 May 2013 supplementing Regulation (EU) No 648/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to regulatory technical standards on colleges for central counterparties (Text with EEA relevance)
